loginIntro: Manage your clients, documents and enquiries.
welcome: A clear view of your studio.
overviewIntro: Your clients, documents and conversations in one place.
replyHint: A reply is marked as sent only after the email provider accepts it.
searchClients: Find a client by name or email
billingHint: Enter verified issuer information before marking a document as sent. Confirm applicable billing requirements before using printed documents.
financialHint: Amounts use two decimal places. The fixed discount is distributed before line tax; quantities allow three decimals. Totals are recalculated on the server.
draftHint: Issued records are locked. Only drafts can be edited or deleted.
paymentHint: Enter the cumulative amount received, not an additional payment.
numberHint: A unique document number is assigned when saved.
settingsHint: These details are copied into new or edited drafts. Issued documents keep their original details.
setupRequired: The admin database is not configured or migrated. Follow docs/admin-dashboard.md to set up storage and create an administrator.
emailUnavailable: Reply delivery is not configured. Set RESEND_API_KEY and CONTACT_FROM_EMAIL on the server.
emailNotice: Business email notification: {status}. The enquiry is saved in the inbox.
emptyHint: New records will appear here as you add them.
errorHint: Please try again. If this continues, check the server configuration.
notificationHelp: Reading a message also clears its notification.
replySuccess: Reply accepted by the email provider.
printHint: Print or save as PDF using your browser.
sessionsHint: Sessions expire after eight hours. Password resets and disabling users are available through the private admin:user command.

confirm.deleteClient: Delete this client? Clients with financial documents cannot be deleted.
confirm.deleteDocument: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.
confirm.cancelInvoice: Cancel this invoice? It will be retained in your records.
confirm.markPaid: Confirm that the full invoice amount has been received.
confirm.markSent: Confirm this document has been sent to the client. This locks its financial details.

errors.validation: Check the required fields and values.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.unavailable: The service is unavailable. Please try again.
errors.setup_required: Configure and migrate the admin database first.
errors.conflict: This record changed. Reload it before trying again.
errors.client_has_documents: This client has financial documents and cannot be deleted.
errors.draft_only: Only drafts can be edited or deleted.
errors.invalid_transition: This status change is not allowed.
errors.issuer_required: Add your business name in Settings, then save the draft again before sending.
errors.accepted_only: Only accepted estimates can become invoices.
errors.discount_exceeds_subtotal: The discount cannot exceed the subtotal.
errors.money_range: The amount is outside the supported range.
errors.payment_range: The received amount must increase and cannot exceed the invoice total.
errors.email_unconfigured: Email delivery is not configured. Your reply has not been sent.
errors.email_failed: Email delivery failed. Your reply is saved but is not marked as sent. Retry the same reply.
errors.reply_pending: This reply needs delivery verification. Wait two minutes and retry the same request; do not send a duplicate.
errors.unsupported_media_type: The request format is not supported.
errors.payload_too_large: The form is too large. Shorten the text or use fewer lines.
errors.invalid_json: The request could not be read.
